title: dump-call-edges
summary: Diagnostic that dumps every resolved call edge in the index as refid|targetqname|confidence rows
intro: Read this when callgraph, find-callees or call-path give a surprising answer and you want the raw material: it prints every resolved call edge in the index as ref_id|target_qname|confidence rows. Troubleshooting tool; needs a project index (--db).

surfaces.usage: drag-lint dump-call-edges --db PATH (diagnostic: resolved call edges: ref_id|target_qname|confidence)
help: drag-lint dump-call-edges --db PATH     (diagnostic: resolved call edges: ref_id|target_qname|confidence)
